g23-fixture-corpus.v4 established the linux-arm64 / linux-x86_64 / macos-arm64 / macos-x86_64 layout. g20-fixture-corpus.v7 adopts that layout for the 8x4=32 surface copies and the 2x4=8 NT copies. Occupancy v2 passProperty over four platforms is preserved, not waived.

Whether the seven occupancy v2 retainedEvidence[2] cancellation traces require their own payloads, or remain witnessed inside the four config/fault/progress/doctor cells, is not decided here.

Whether a later D-002 admission of a second external role invalidates g20-fixture-corpus.v7 or extends the axis is not decided here. occupancy v2 componentRoleAxis.laterRoles says a newly admitted role enters the axis by that admission; g20-fixture-corpus.v7 enumerates slice 1 only.
The SARIF cell is a record of non-advertisement quoted from occupancy v2 exactByteIntent. A later schema for that cell, if any, is not decided here.

How concrete an envelope, log record, or refusal record may be before it becomes an invented SDK API remains reserved. g20-fixture-corpus.v7 quotes occupancy and file 02 and does not name envelope fields.
A later dedicated SATISFIED-GRADE cycle may test DR-G20 only when D-056 five gates hold. Gate 1 Class A remains unopened. g20-fixture-corpus.v7 is not that cycle.
